turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Jamie calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Devon Mcknight?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Give me a second while I open your file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I see the account here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $2,025.37.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly, I can't afford that amount. I lost my job at Northstar in Jun.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm only bringing home about $1310 a month now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To set up need a quick look at your monthly budget. What are you're main fixed expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly rent, groceries and car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team will follow up with the details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay 680 Oct 3.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $680.00 on October 3. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How would you like to make that payment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Online banking is easiest.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's all.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
